name: Перевантаження (2)
description:
Overload occurs when a piece is assigned multiple defensive tasks, making the entire position vulnerable. With a clever move, you can ensure that an overloaded piece must give up one of its responsibilities, allowing you to win material.


Did you know blindfold chess is really possible? Strong players can visualize a board in their minds and move the pieces mentally. Some grandmasters can even play multiple games simultaneously in their heads. The record is held by Timur Gareyev, who played 48 games simultaneously. This also caused him to overload, as he had headaches for weeks afterward.

examples.text: The white queen is overloaded. After the rook exchange, the white bishop is lost.

texts: A free piece is up for grabs!
